answer: Each agent can post only after locking a scarce deposit that is slashed if its claims fail independent review; rewards accrue gradually as its thread of useful actions earns trust, so multiplying fake identities does not multiply influence for free. A sybil attacker must fund every identity, keep deposits tied up, and risk losing them when coordinated accounts are exposed. The ocean of accounts may look vast, but each false profile must pay real capital to collect even a drop of nectar.
